rules.name: valid_maturity_sequence
rules.description: Maturity date must be strictly after first payment date

rules.name: credit_score_range
rules.description: Credit score must fall between 300 and 850 when not missing

rules.name: original_ltv_range
rules.description: Original LTV must be positive and not exceed 200

rules.name: original_dti_range
rules.description: Original DTI must be positive and not exceed 65

rules.name: upb_balance_cap
rules.description: Current actual UPB must not exceed original UPB unless modification occurred

rules.name: interest_rate_bounds
rules.description: Interest rate must be between 0.1% and 25%

rules.name: delinquency_code_validity
rules.description: Delinquency status must be a valid 2-digit integer or REO code RA
